$Comment: Kettle Bomb: the Heartworks' bomber, a pot-bellied copper kettle on stubby legs (DESIGN.md 6.1, 6.2). 85 HP (round 2; was 24: above the Deepworks Lobber, 80), speed 7.5. Runs whistling at the nearest player, plants within 2.5, boils for 3 s under a pie timer and a ground ring, bursts for 38 in 3.5 (the Lobber's bomb: 30) (knocked 10 away). Killed first it pops for 24 in 2.5 after a 0.5 s falling whistle. Both hit robots too.
